title: Hamster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- legs (dancing, spread) -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='89' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f7c98a'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='89' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f7c98a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='21' fill='#f2b570'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#fde3bd'/>
  <!-- arms raised, dancing -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='56' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e0a060' transform='rotate(-35 24 56)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='56' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e0a060' transform='rotate(35 76 56)'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='49' r='5' fill='#f7c98a'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='49' r='5' fill='#f7c98a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#f2b570'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='24' r='7' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='24' r='7' fill='#e0a060'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#f9c9a0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#f9c9a0'/>
  <!-- cheek patches -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='47' r='6' fill='#f58aa0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='47' r='6' fill='#f58aa0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#2b1d3f'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#2b1d3f'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose & mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#d96b8a'/>
  <path d='M50 48 Q46 53 43 50' stroke='#b5546f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 48 Q54 53 57 50' stroke='#b5546f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- buck teeth -->
  <rect x='47.5' y='50' width='5' height='4' rx='1' fill='#fdfaf0'/>
  <!-- little music notes showing the dance -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='30' r='3' fill='#7e6be0'/>
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='1.8' height='12' fill='#7e6be0'/>
  <path d='M23.8 18 Q28 20 27 24' stroke='#7e6be0' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='26' r='3' fill='#7e6be0'/>
  <rect x='82' y='14' width='1.8' height='12' fill='#7e6be0'/>
  <path d='M83.8 14 Q88 16 87 20' stroke='#7e6be0' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
</svg>
